description: MainActivity class for an Android app that manages notes. It handles UI interactions, search functionality, loading and deleting notes, and navigation to the editor activity.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: An AppCompatActivity subclass that serves as the main screen for note management, providing search, navigation, and delete functionalities.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up UI components, and configures event listeners.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Reloads notes when the activity resumes.

methods.name: setupSearch
methods.description: Configures search view listeners for filtering notes.

methods.name: loadNotes
methods.description: Fetches notes from repository, either all or filtered by query, and updates the UI.

methods.name: openEditor
methods.description: Starts the activity for editing or creating a note, passing the note ID if editing.

methods.name: confirmDelete
methods.description: Deletes a note and shows a toast message indicating success or failure.
